verdict.seller_message: Hi, I wanted to let you know that infant swings with an incline over 10 degrees have been banned since November 2022 under the Safe Sleep for Babies Act (16 CFR 1310), and this Vevor model has also been recalled by the CPSC (recall #26074). Older crib but sturdy. The front side slides down so it's easy to lift baby out. Mattress not included.
Photo: U.S. CPSC recall notice #10046

verdict.summary: This is a U.S. solid wood crib with a drop-side design. The verdict is Don't buy because drop-side cribs cannot be legally resold under the federal crib standard effective June 28, 2011, even if the side has been immobilized.
verdict.seller_message: Hi, thanks for listing this crib. I wanted to let you know that drop-side cribs can't be resold under the current federal safety standard (16 CFR 1219/1220; CPSIA §104(c)), even if the side has been fixed in place. For that reason I'll have to pass, but I appreciate you offering it.
verdict.safer_alternative: Look for a fixed-side crib manufactured after June 2011 that includes all original parts, instructions, and a label showing the model number and manufacture date.
